title: Weather
examples: Can we see rainbows every day?

explain.say: Today we learn about weather around us.
The sun gives us warm light and heat.
Rain falls from the sky in drops.
Wind is moving air that we feel.
Clouds are big groups of tiny water drops.
When you play outside, you might see a rainbow after the rain. The rainbow shows that the sunlight hit the water drops in the air. This shows how light and water interact.

faq.q: Why are the clouds white sometimes?
faq.a: Clouds look white because they are made of tiny water droplets. Sometimes they look grey when they have more water.
asks: What makes clouds look different colors?

faq.a: Snow happens when the air is very cold and the water falls as ice crystals. These crystals are what we call snow.
asks: What is the difference between snow and hail?

faq.a: A rainbow is a beautiful arc of colors in the sky. You need sunshine and raindrops to see one.

faq.q: Can wind blow things very far?
faq.a: Yes, strong winds can blow things like leaves and small sticks a long way. It is the movement of air.
asks: What moves things in the air?

faq.q: What is the difference between rain and snow?
faq.a: Rain is liquid water falling from the sky. Snow is frozen water that falls as white crystals.
No, clouds can just float by without raining. They can also look fluffy and white.
asks: What if the clouds are dark?

facts: The sun provides light and heat energy.
Rain is water falling from the atmosphere.
Wind is simply the movement of air.
Rainbows show light bending through water.

quiz.say: When the air is very cold, water can fall as:
quiz.why: Snow is the form of water that falls when the air temperature is very low.

wrong.0: Wind is moving air, not falling water.
wrong.1: Sunshine is light, not falling water.
wrong.3: Rain is liquid water, which falls when it is warmer.

quiz.say: What do you need to see a rainbow?
quiz.why: A rainbow is formed when sunlight shines through falling raindrops.

wrong.0: Snow is solid, not the right kind of water droplets.
wrong.2: Clouds can block the rainbow from being seen.
wrong.3: Wind moves things but does not create the colors.

quiz.say: If the air is moving, we call it:
quiz.why: Wind is the scientific word for air that is moving from one place to another.

wrong.0: Rain is water falling from the sky.
wrong.1: A cloud is a visible group of water vapor.
wrong.3: The sun is a star that gives out light.
